de: Verbringen Sie einen Nachmittag im Victoria Park, der 'grünen Lunge' von East London.
Erkunden Sie das Victoria Park Village für exklusive Delikatessen und Boutiquen.
Spazieren Sie am Regent's Canal entlang in Richtung Hackney Wick für Street-Art-Vibes.
Besuchen Sie den Well Street Market am Wochenende für lokales Kunsthandwerk.
Nutzen Sie den Bus, da das Viertel keine eigene U-Bahn-Station besitzt.
hu: Tölts el egy délutánt a Victoria Parkban, London egyik legkedveltebb közparkjában!
Fedezd fel a Victoria Park Village hangulatos butikjait és kézműves boltjait!
Sétálj a Regent's Canal mentén Hackney Wick felé a látványos graffitikért!
Nézz ki a Well Street Marketre, ahol helyi termékeket és művészeti tárgyakat találsz.
Készülj fel buszozásra, mivel a környéknek nincs közvetlen metrókapcsolata.
ro: Petrece o după-amiază în Victoria Park, cel mai îndrăgit parc public din estul Londrei.
Explorează Victoria Park Village pentru buticuri cochete și delicatese artizanale.
Plimbă-te pe malul canalului Regent's spre Hackney Wick pentru a vedea arta stradală.
Vizitează Well Street Market în weekend pentru produse locale și meșteșuguri.
Bazează-te pe autobuze, deoarece zona nu dispune de o stație de metrou proprie.
en: Spend an afternoon in Victoria Park, known as the 'People's Park' of East London.
Explore Victoria Park Village for its artisan delis and independent boutiques.
Walk along the Regent's Canal towards Hackney Wick to spot vibrant street art.
Visit Well Street Market on weekends for local crafts and a historic market feel.
Travel by bus or walk from nearby Overground stations as there is no local Tube stop.
